success.description: # You invoke the blessing and your Strength is increased by 1.

boon.description: Your target’s Strength is increased by 1 as well.

reckless.requirements: For S favour. Engaged with a target with a higher Strength rating than you. Effect: Verena redresses an imbalance. While this blessing is recharging, your Strength is increased as described below. This blessing won't increase your Strength beyond that of your target.
